text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I thought I heard somebody calling my name, but…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It seems there's nobody here. Was I hearing things?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Could it have been… the statue of the Three Goddesses?
